synopsis: Continental appears in the sensor-validation evidence through Schmoll et al. (2024), which compared an ultrasonic model in CarMaker with a real Continental sensor; this was the only ultrasonic simulation validation found in the corpus [f4761, f4575]. The study included IPG Automotive and Continental authors, creating a tension between its “Independent on-road” label and the explicit conclusion that it is a published technical study rather than vendor-independent evidence [f4575, f4576]. Separately, Continental is a documented automotive collaborator for AVxcelerate Sensors, but that collaboration does not establish off-road performance [f8536]. These facts therefore offer on-road technical validation and collaboration evidence, not demonstrated off-road performance or vendor-independent validation [f4575, f4576, f8536].

relations.note: Both describe the 2024 CarMaker ultrasonic validation against a real Continental sensor.
The Independent label conflicts with the explicit assessment that author affiliations preclude vendor independence.
